# Motorola US

> Motorola US is the official United States website for Motorola smartphones, foldable phones, accessories, Moto AI experiences, connected devices, business solutions, customer support, company information, and legal resources.

Motorola designs and delivers smartphones, accessories, software, and connected-device experiences that help people discover, share, and connect with the world around them. Since 1928, Motorola has focused on purposeful innovation by combining advanced technology with intuitive user experiences.

## Website

- [Motorola US Homepage](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/homepage): Official Motorola US website for smartphones, accessories, connected devices, services, and special offers.

## About Motorola

- [About Motorola](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about): Information about Motorola, its brand, organization, technology, and values.
- [Contact Motorola](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/contact): Official Motorola contact and customer-service information.
- [Motorola Executive Team](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/motorola-executive-team): Information about Motorola s executive leadership team.
- [Motorola History](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/motorola-history): Key milestones, inventions, and developments in Motorola s history.
- [Motorola Licensing](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/licensing): Information about Motorola brand and technology licensing.

## Corporate Responsibility

- [Corporate Responsibility](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility): Overview of Motorola s corporate-responsibility commitments and programs.
- [Business Conduct](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-business-conduct): Information about Motorola s ethical business standards and conduct.
- [Consumer Accessibility](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-consumer-accessibility): Information about accessibility across Motorola products and services.
- [Responsible Driving](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-consumer-driving): Guidance about the responsible use of mobile devices while driving.
- [Consumer Health](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-consumer-health): Consumer health and safety information relating to Motorola products.
- [Consumer Responsibility](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-consumers): Information about Motorola s consumer-focused responsibility practices.
- [Environmental Responsibility](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-environment): Information about Motorola s environmental commitments and initiatives.
- [Materials Disclosure](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-materials-disclosure): Product-material and regulated-substance disclosure information.
- [Responsible Operations](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-operations): Information about responsible practices across Motorola operations.
- [Responsible Product Design](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-product-design): Information about sustainability and responsibility in product design.
- [Recycling](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-recycling): Information about Motorola device and electronics recycling.
- [Supplier Responsibility](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-suppliers): Information about Motorola s supplier standards and responsibility requirements.

## Special Offers and Deals

- [Motorola Smartphone Deals](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/specials): View current Motorola smartphone, accessory, and device offers.

## Smartphones

- [All Motorola Smartphones](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/smartphones): Browse Motorola Android smartphones, including foldable, premium, and value-focused devices.
- [Motorola Razr Phones](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/razr): Explore Motorola Razr foldable and flip smartphones.
- [Motorola Edge Phones](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/edge): Explore Motorola Edge smartphones, features, and available models.
- [Moto G Phones](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/g): Explore Moto G smartphones across different features and price points.
- [Compare Motorola Smartphones](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/compare/): Compare specifications and features across eligible Motorola smartphone models.

## Featured Smartphones

- [Motorola Razr Fold](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/razr/razr-fold/pmipmjj43my): Product details, features, specifications, and purchasing information for Motorola Razr Fold.
- [Motorola Razr Ultra 2026](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/razr/razr-ultra-2026/pmipmjk44m3): Product details and specifications for Motorola Razr Ultra 2026.
- [Motorola Razr Plus 2026](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/razr/razr-plus-2026/pmipmjq44ms): Product details and specifications for Motorola Razr Plus 2026.
- [Motorola Razr 2026](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/razr/razr-2026/pmipmjl44m7): Product details and specifications for Motorola Razr 2026.
- [Motorola Razr Ultra](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/razr/razr-ultra/pmipmhn40ms): Product details and specifications for Motorola Razr Ultra.
- [Motorola Razr Plus Gen 3](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/razr/razr-plus-gen-3/razrplus2025): Product details and specifications for Motorola Razr Plus Gen 3.
- [Motorola Razr FIFA World Cup 26 Edition](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/razr/razr-gen-5/fifaworldcup26edition): Product information for the Motorola Razr FIFA World Cup 26 Edition.
- [Motorola Edge Gen 6](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/motorola-edge/edge-gen-6/pmipmhp40mv): Product details and specifications for Motorola Edge Gen 6.
- [Moto G 2026](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/moto-g/moto-g-2026/pmipmhz42mm): Product details and specifications for Moto G 2026.
- [Moto G Power 2026](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/moto-g/moto-g-power-2026/pmipmjb42mv): Product details and specifications for Moto G Power 2026.
- [Moto G Play 2026](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/moto-g/moto-g-play-2026/pmipmja42mq): Product details and specifications for Moto G Play 2026.
- [Moto G Stylus Gen 5](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/phones/moto-g/g-stylus-gen-5/pmipmhl40me): Product details and specifications for Moto G Stylus Gen 5.

## Moto AI

- [Moto AI](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/moto-ai): Information about Motorola AI features, supported experiences, and compatible devices.

## Accessories

- [All Motorola Accessories](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/all-accessories): Browse Motorola accessories for smartphones and connected devices.
- [Moto Tags](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/moto-tags): Explore Motorola tracking tags and compatible accessories.
- [Cases and Phone Protection](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/all-cases-and-protection): Browse protective cases and accessories for Motorola phones.
- [Headphones and Earbuds](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/headphones): Explore Motorola headphones, wireless earbuds, and audio devices.
- [Chargers and Power Accessories](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/power-and-charger): Browse Motorola chargers, cables, and power accessories.
- [Wearables](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/wearables): Explore Motorola smartwatches, fitness devices, and wearables.
- [Moto Things Accessories](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/moto-things-accessories): Browse accessories for Motorola connected-device experiences.
- [Motorola Tablets](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/tablet): Explore Motorola Android tablets and related products.

## Featured Accessories

- [Moto Tag 2](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/motoaccessories/moto-tag-2/pg38c08034): Product details and specifications for Moto Tag 2.
- [Brilliant Collection Signature Buds 2 Plus](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/motoaccessories/brilliant-collection-signature-buds-2-plus/pg38c08989): Product details for Motorola Signature Buds 2 Plus.
- [Moto Buds Loop](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/motoaccessories/moto-buds-loop/pg38c07175): Product details and specifications for Moto Buds Loop.
- [Moto Watch 2026](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/motoaccessories/moto-watch-2026/pg38c08256): Product details and specifications for Moto Watch 2026.
- [Moto Watch Fit](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/motoaccessories/moto-watch-fit-smartwatch-1/pg38c07186): Product details and specifications for Moto Watch Fit.
- [Moto Pen Ultra](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/p/motoaccessories/moto-pen-ultra/pg38c08252): Product details and specifications for Moto Pen Ultra.

## Business Solutions

- [Motorola Business Solutions](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/business): Motorola smartphones, services, and mobility solutions for businesses.
- [Contact Motorola Business](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/business/contact-us): Contact Motorola about business products and enterprise requirements.
- [ThinkShield for Mobile](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/thinkshield): Information about Motorola mobile security and device-protection solutions.
- [Home and Office Phones](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/home-office-phones): Motorola communication devices for home and office use.

## Smart Home and Connected Devices

- [Security and Surveillance](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/security-surveillance): Explore Motorola security and surveillance products.
- [Smart Monitors](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/smart-monitors): Browse Motorola smart monitors and connected monitoring devices.
- [Modems and Networking](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/family/modems-networking): Explore Motorola modems, Wi-Fi devices, and home-networking products.

## Support and Services

- [Carrier Compatibility](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/carrier-compatibility): Check Motorola smartphone compatibility with supported US mobile carriers.
- [Track an Order](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/trackmyorder): Track an eligible Motorola US order.
- [Moto Care](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/moto-care/): Learn about Motorola device-protection plans and support services.
- [Motorola Trade-In](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/moto-trade-in): Review Motorola smartphone trade-in options and eligibility.
- [Switch to Motorola](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/switch): Find guidance about switching from another smartphone to a Motorola device.
- [Motorola Video Resources](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/videopage): Watch Motorola product, feature, and support videos.

## Privacy and Legal

- [Motorola Privacy Statement](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/privacy-statement): Review Motorola s primary privacy statement.
- [Data Privacy Rights](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/data-privacy-rights): Information about exercising eligible data-privacy rights.
- [Website Privacy Policy](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/legal/privacy-policy): Review privacy terms applying to the Motorola website.
- [Product Privacy](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/legal/product-privacy): Privacy information relating to Motorola products and services.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/legal/terms-of-use): Terms governing use of the Motorola website.
- [Terms of Sale](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/legal/terms-of-sale): Terms applying to purchases made through Motorola.
- [Trade-In Terms and Conditions](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/trade-in-terms-and-conditions): Terms and conditions governing Motorola s trade-in programme.

## Accessibility

- [Consumer Accessibility](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/corporate-responsibility-consumer-accessibility): Information about accessibility across Motorola products and services.
- [Hearing Aid Compatibility](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/hearing-aid-compatibility-us): Hearing-aid compatibility information for Motorola devices in the United States.
- [TTY Compatibility](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/about/tty-compatibility-us): TTY compatibility information for eligible Motorola devices.

## Additional Resources

- [Country Selector](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/country-selector): Select another Motorola country or regional website.
- [Progressive Leasing](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/progressiveleasing): Information about eligible lease-to-own purchasing options.
- [Military Discount](https://www.motorola.com/us/en/military-discount): Eligibility and conditions for Motorola s US military discount.

    const injectMolecule = function(root) {

  <script>(function offerFixTemp() {
      'use strict';
      if (window.__offerFix || !/\/p\//.test(location.pathname)) return;
      window.__offerFix = true;
      window.__offerFixOff = window.__offerFixOff || false;   // kill switch: window.__offerFixOff = true

      const TAG = '[offerFix]';
      const API = 'getProductOffer';
      const off = () => window.__offerFixOff === true;
      const isSubseries = pn => /^PMIP/i.test(pn || '');
      let lastOfferPn = null;

      const metaPc = () => document.querySelector('meta[name="productcode" i]')?.content || '';
      const getPn = () => {
        const pn = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('pn') || metaPc();
        return pn && !isSubseries(pn) ? pn : '';
      };

      // A. Rewrite only bad getProductOffer requests
      const fixUrl = (raw) => {
        try {
          if (off() || !String(raw).includes(API)) return raw;
          const u = new URL(raw, location.origin);
          const pn = u.searchParams.get('productNumber');
          lastOfferPn = pn;
          const good = getPn();
          if (isSubseries(pn) && good) {
            u.searchParams.set('productNumber', good);
            lastOfferPn = good;
            console.warn(`${TAG} ${pn} → ${good}`);
            return u.toString();
          }
        } catch (e) { }
        return raw;
      };

      const _fetch = window.fetch;
      window.fetch = function (input, init) {
        try {
          if (!off()) {
            const isReq = typeof Request !== 'undefined' && input instanceof Request;
            const raw = isReq ? input.url : String(input);
            if (raw.includes(API)) {
              const url = fixUrl(raw);
              if (url !== raw) input = isReq ? new Request(url, input) : url;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) { }
        return _fetch.call(this, input, init);
      };

      const _open = XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open;
      XMLHttpRequest.prototype.open = function (method, url, ...rest) {
        try { if (!off() && String(url).includes(API)) url = fixUrl(url); } catch (e) { }
        return _open.call(this, method, url, ...rest);
      };

      // B. Fix the store and reload offers if the first request already went out wrong
      const findStore = () => {
        for (const el of document.body.querySelectorAll('*')) {
          const app = el.__vue_app__;
          if (!app) continue;
          const cands = [app.config?.globalProperties?.$pinia];
          for (const k of Reflect.ownKeys(app._context?.provides || {})) cands.push(app._context.provides[k]);
          for (const p of cands) if (p?._s instanceof Map && p._s.has('product')) return p._s.get('product');
        }
        return null;
      };
      const hasOffers = s => Array.isArray(s.productOffer) ? s.productOffer.length > 0 : !!s.productOffer;

      const sync = async (store) => {
        try {
          if (off()) return;
          const codes = (store.model || []).map(m => m.productCode);
          const cur0 = store.currentProductNumber;
          if (!cur0 || isSubseries(cur0) || !codes.includes(cur0)) {
            const target = [getPn(), metaPc()].find(p => p && codes.includes(p)) || codes[0];
            if (target) {
              console.warn(`${TAG} store pn "${cur0}" → "${target}"`);
              store.currentProductNumber = target;
            }
          }
          const cur = store.currentProductNumber;
          if (cur && !isSubseries(cur) && (!hasOffers(store) || isSubseries(lastOfferPn))) {
            console.log(`${TAG} reloading offers for ${cur}`);
            await store.getPorductOffers();
            console.log(`${TAG} offers:`, store.productOffer);
          }
        } catch (e) { console.warn(`${TAG} sync skipped`, e); }
      };

      let tries = 0, stopWatch = null;
      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        try {
          if (off() || ++tries > 100) return clearInterval(timer);
          const store = findStore();
          if (!store || !(store.model || []).length) return;
          clearInterval(timer);
          window.__store = window.__store || store;
          sync(store);
          stopWatch = store.$subscribe(() => {
            try {
              if (off() || hasOffers(store)) { stopWatch && stopWatch(); return; }
              const cur = store.currentProductNumber;
              if (cur && !isSubseries(cur) && lastOfferPn !== cur) sync(store);
            } catch (e) { }
          });
        } catch (e) { clearInterval(timer); }
      }, 300);

      console.log(`${TAG} active. pn=${getPn() || '(none yet)'}. Disable with: window.__offerFixOff = true`);
    })();</script>
